name: Asbestos Abatement Notification Requirements, Thresholds, and Fees by State
description: Notification requirements for asbestos abatement and demolition projects vary by state. The federal NESHAP (40 CFR 61 Subpart M) requires 10 working days' notice for projects exceeding 260 linear feet, 160 square feet, or 35 cubic feet of regulated asbestos-containing material. States with delegated authority impose their own notification fees, advance-notice periods, material quantity thresholds, and exemptions. This table gives the notification trigger, advance-notice period, fee structure, and delegated authority for each state so a contractor knows what is required before starting work.

records.delegated_authority: Connecticut Department of Public Health, Asbestos Program
records.notification_trigger_threshold: All asbestos abatement projects require notification; all demolitions require notification even if no asbestos is present
records.notification_fee: $100.00 for abatement less than 160 square feet; $100.00 plus one percent (multiply cost by 0.01) of the total abatement cost (excluding cost to reinsulate) up to a maximum fee of $5,000.00 for abatement of 160 square feet or greater; $50.00 for demolition notification; $200.00 for alternative work practice application
records.residential_exemption: No specific residential exemption stated in state notification fee schedule; follows federal NESHAP exemption
records.emergency_notification_rules: An Emergency notification must be filed within one (1) working day. Contractors should discuss with program staff before proceeding with an emergency filing unless the facility poses an imminent risk of harming the public.
records.statute_or_regulation_citation: Connecticut Department of Public Health Asbestos Program notification requirements
records.source_quote: An initial asbestos notification must be post marked, or hand delivered at least ten (10) days prior to the start of asbestos abatement.

records.delegated_authority: EPA, with delegation available to state agencies under 40 CFR 61.04
records.notification_trigger_threshold: All demolitions regardless of asbestos amount; renovations at least 80 linear meters (260 linear feet) on pipes or at least 15 square meters (160 square feet) on other facility components, or at least 1 cubic meter (35 cubic feet) off facility components
records.residential_exemption: Facility excludes residential buildings having four or fewer dwelling units
records.emergency_notification_rules: As early as possible before, but not later than, the following working day
records.source_quote: Facility means any institutional, commercial, public, industrial, or residential structure, installation, or building (including any structure, installation, or building containing condominiums or individual dwelling units operated as a residential cooperative, but excluding residential buildings having four or fewer dwelling units); any ship; and any active or inactive waste disposal site.

records.delegated_authority: Georgia Environmental Protection Division, Lead-Based Paint and Asbestos Program
records.notification_trigger_threshold: All demolitions regardless of asbestos amount; any project involving ten (10) or more continuous linear feet or ten (10) or more square feet of asbestos-containing material for renovations/abatement
records.notification_fee: $0.10 per square foot of friable asbestos-containing materials plus $0.10 linear foot of friable asbestos-containing materials, with a minimum of $25 for any project; but not to exceed $50 for any small project or residential dwelling project nor exceed $1,000 for any other project
records.residential_exemption: Legal owners or residences where four (4) or fewer dwelling units are involved, unless part of a larger project, are exempt from demolition project notification requirements
records.emergency_notification_rules: Notification of the emergency situation should be submitted within 24 hours from the time of its occurrence, or from the time you are contacted with a request for emergency work to be performed
records.statute_or_regulation_citation: Georgia Department of Natural Resources Rules for Air Quality Control, Chapter 391-3-1-.02(9)(b)7; Georgia Rules of Asbestos Removal and Encapsulation, Chapter 391-3-14
records.source_quote: $0.10 per square foot of friable asbestos-containing materials plus $0.10 linear foot of friable asbestos-containing materials, with a minimum of $25 for any project; but not to exceed $50 for any small project or residential dwelling project nor exceed $1,000 for any other project.

records.notification_trigger_threshold: Projects subject to the requirements of the national emission standard for hazardous air pollutants (NESHAP) for asbestos
records.notification_fee: $100 for each required original or each annual notification for each demolition or renovation, including abatement
records.residential_exemption: Follows federal NESHAP exemption for residential buildings having four or fewer dwelling units
records.statute_or_regulation_citation: 567 IAC 23.2(3); Iowa Environmental Protection Commission rules adopted December 15, 2015
records.source_quote: Asbestos notification fee is $100 for each required original or each annual notification for each demolition or renovation, including abatement.

records.delegated_authority: Minnesota Department of Health, Asbestos Program
records.notification_trigger_threshold: Friable ACM exceeding 260 linear feet on pipes, 160 square feet on other components, or 35 cubic feet; residential projects exceeding 10 linear feet, 6 square feet, or 1 cubic foot
records.notification_fee: $35 permit fee for residential projects with friable ACM less than 160 square feet; 3% of total project cost for all other notifiable projects
records.residential_exemption: Residential projects with friable ACM below 6 square feet, 10 linear feet, or 1 cubic foot are not notifiable
records.emergency_notification_rules: Contact MDH and MPCA as soon as possible to verify whether the project meets the requirements of an emergency project
records.source_quote: For non-residential or commercial projects (single projects, a series of small projects, and maintenance projects) where the quantity of friable ACM is greater than 160 square feet, 260 linear feet, or 35 cubic feet, the permit fee is 3%.

records.delegated_authority: Texas Department of State Health Services, Asbestos Program (TAHPR)
records.notification_trigger_threshold: Renovation projects which include the disturbance of any asbestos-containing building material in a public building or the disturbance of the NESHAP threshold amount of asbestos-containing material in a facility; demolition of a building or facility, even when no asbestos is present
records.notification_fee: the building owner is required to pay a notification fee that is based upon the amount of asbestos removed, with a minimum fee of $55.00 and a 3% subscription fee per original notification
records.residential_exemption: One private residence is not subject to the asbestos NESHAP regulations and notification is not required
records.emergency_notification_rules: Emergency notifications may be submitted online or hardcopy by mail to the department no later than the following work day after the incident
records.statute_or_regulation_citation: TAHPR, Title 25 of the Texas Administrative Code, Chapter 295, Subchapter C, Section 295.61
records.source_quote: the building owner is required to pay a notification fee that is based upon the amount of asbestos removed, with a minimum fee of $55.00 and a 3% subscription fee per original notification

records.delegated_authority: Virginia Department of Labor and Industry, Safety and Health Codes Board
records.notification_trigger_threshold: any asbestos project of 10 linear feet or more or 10 square feet or more
records.notification_fee: $50 for each project equal to or greater than 10 linear feet or 10 square feet up to and including 260 linear feet or 160 square feet; $160 for each project of more than 260 linear feet or 160 square feet up to and including 2600 linear feet or 1600 square feet; $470 for each project of more than 2600 linear feet or 1600 square feet; blanket notification fee is 0.5% of the contract price or $470 whichever is greater
records.residential_exemption: Follows federal NESHAP exemption for residential buildings having four or fewer dwelling units
records.emergency_notification_rules: Notification and asbestos permit fee shall be submitted within five working days after the start of the emergency abatement; emergencies include protection of life, health, or property such as leaking or ruptured pipes, accidentally damaged or fallen asbestos
records.source_quote: Written notification of any asbestos project of 10 linear feet or more or 10 square feet or more shall be made to the department on a department form. Such notification shall be sent by facsimile transmission as set out in <https://law.lis.virginia.gov/admincode/title16/agency25/chapter20/section30/> 16VAC25-20-30 J, certified mail, or hand-delivered to the department. Notification shall be postmarked or made 20 days before the beginning of any asbestos project.
